newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 485.5/486.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 485.5/486.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed weaker at 485.50/486.75 per dollar as strong interbank dollar demand swamped the Central Bank's usual gentle dollar sales, traders said.
The unit closed Tuesday at 484.00/485.00 per dollar.
"The Central Bank participated as it usually does ... but not enough to meet the demand for dollars that there was today," said one trader at a large bank.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
Traders said the high demand was due to banks selling bolivars acquired in recent days to meet a temporary liquidity squeeze that saw interbank overnight lending rates soar above 50 percent.
